# What do LPs and the sponsor each take home from a real estate syndication?

> Free real estate syndication waterfall calculator: preferred return, IRR hurdles and sponsor promote tiers, with LP and GP IRR, equity multiples and a year-by-year split. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
